# Local security replacement

This package is maintained in this repository, not published by the upstream
maintainer. See `.superstack/security-reports/lumenless-privacy-2026-10-15.md`
at the repository root for provenance, the exact security changes, advisories,
validation and remaining limitations. Tests are in
`web/tests/dependency-hardening.test.cjs`. Copies in web and mobile must match;
CI checks their contents. Replace with a reviewed upstream fix when available.
